reason: B gives me more to score against a rubric: the urgency of the June departure and the five-month hiring lag, six-month reporting, and a candid admission that there is no baseline for unrepresented tenants, with a plan to get one. It wins only narrowly because the unfilled "[County]" placeholders look unfinished, its claim that capacity "will fall by half" without the grant goes beyond the facts, and A is the one that discloses the county contract risk.
